_meta.title: Breakdown (SAM3 cutouts)
_meta.description: One CLIPTextEncode + SAM3_Detect (individual_masks=true) per part; the builder clones nodes 3+4 for each comma-separated part (max 8) and wires them to CJCutouts masks, masks_2 .. masks_8, with the part names as labels. A ':N' suffix on a part caps its detections (SAM3 tokenizer syntax; builder default :4). CJCutouts drops masks under min_area_frac of the frame and masks whose IoU with an earlier kept one exceeds dedupe_iou, then saves a labelled contact sheet first (job image) and every instance as an RGBA PNG cropped to its bbox + padding (CJ_Breakdown/part).
